## Review and acceptance

- [ ] Diff matches approved scope and contains no secrets/private data.
- [ ] Relevant acceptance criteria and required checks have evidence.
- [ ] Review findings have been resolved and affected checks repeated.
- [ ] Required owner acceptance is recorded before merge/closure.

Keep partial work in draft and its issue open. Use automatic closing keywords only after full issue acceptance. Preserve meaningful plan and implementation commits under the agreed merge policy.
